summary: The diff implements all seven AggregateError steps in order, each with its spec comment above the code: NewTarget fallback, OrdinaryCreateFromConstructor with the [[ErrorData]] slot, the message ToString and non-enumerable define, InstallErrorCause, GetIterator plus IteratorToList, CreateArrayFromList, and the errors property define with writable, non-enumerable, configurable. Errors propagate with `?`, and nothing is special-cased or faked. The one gate lint is the `.expect("a built-in runs with an active function")` on the NewTarget fallback. I judge it unreachable from JS, since a built-in always runs with an active function, so I am not counting it as a defect. Helper signatures in kahvi_core::ops and PropertyDescriptor::data argument order are not visible to me; I rely on the clean build and the 30 new passing test262 tests for those. Minor: step 6 uses `?` where the spec uses `!`, which is not observable for a fresh ordinary object.
